symbols.read: The bullish structure holds but momentum keeps eroding: price slipped from 743.69 to 741.81 and the 1H printed a second consecutive down bar (741.15→740.37, -0.11%), keeping the combined signal at HOLD while the 4H stays bullish. The bull FVG at 739.63–739.88 remains open just below price and still overlaps the 737.02 support, so a dip into that band is a buy zone rather than a breakdown — the invalidated SELL at 722.40 stays dead. Bias remains bullish toward the 758.44 upper pivot; invalidation is a sustained move below 737.02, which would reopen 722.40 and then 686.36.

Price has pulled back to 82,801.83 from the prior 83,150.01, and the 82,664.01–82,805.35 bull FVG cited last time no longer appears in the open-FVG list, so that zone has been consumed rather than stacked as fresh demand. Bias stays bullish on the 4H direction and 1H uptrend, but the combined call remains HOLD and momentum is softer, with price now sitting just under the 82,805.35 top of the former gap. The remaining demand is the two bull FVGs at 81,777.63–82,100.00 and 82,171.80–82,211.21, with 84,352.00 the upside pivot for continuation and 81,033.66 the lower pivot whose break revives the bear case. Invalidation of the bullish lean is unchanged: a close back below the 81,777.63 FVG base.

Price has slipped back to 2,443.58, retreating from the 2,455.39 of the prior read and re-entering the 2,441.67–2,444.52 zone it had cleared, so the breakout lacks follow-through even though the 4H direction, 1H uptrend, and bullish regime all remain intact. The constructive bias holds but is weaker: the combined signal stays HOLD, the SELL is still flagged invalidated, and the last 1H bar (-0.18%) extends the soft momentum noted before. The 2,403.94–2,409.12 bullish FVG and the 2,403.69 lower pivot remain the demand base and the line in the sand, with 2,579.88 the upside target. Invalidation is unchanged: a close below 2,403.69 reopens the 2,354.54–2,370.66 shelf and the 2,227.50 target. What changed versus the prior read is the failed hold above the reclaimed FVG — bias stays constructive but now needs a decisive push back through 2,444.52 to reassert itself.

Price has rolled back to 105.79, fully out of the 106.61–106.82 pivot zone, and the last 1H bar (106.29→105.86, -0.40%) is a third consecutive red close — momentum has weakened further versus the prior read, though the 1H trend still reads up and FVGs remain empty. The 107.16 lower pivot is now further away, so the long trigger toward 113.40 is even less imminent and the bias shifts to neutral, leaning bearish on the fading 1H. The SELL setup stays invalidated (entry 107.16, stop 107.19), keeping the 100.92 target off the table, and the 4H bearish direction plus HOLD combined stance argue against chasing the long. Invalidation is unchanged: a close below the 104.46 zone revives the bear case toward 100.92, while only a clean break of 107.16 opens 113.40.

Price has dropped to 57.35, breaking below the 57.198–57.367 bull FVG that previously underpinned the range, and the 1H has flipped to down — so the combined read has shifted from HOLD/neutral to SELL/bearish. The prior neutral stance is revised: the bearish case is now active, with the 58.41 pivot confirmed as resistance overhead and a fresh bear FVG at 57.684–57.7505 capping any bounce. The 58.41 short entry has expired untriggered again, so no live position exists; the bias is bearish toward 55.37. Invalidation: a sustained reclaim of 58.41 flips the read bullish toward 61.45.

Price has edged up to 4,117.88 from 4,114.10 but remains below the 4,141.44 pivot, so the bearish structure is unchanged and the prior read's thesis holds. The one shift is the combined 4H+1H read moving from bearish to HOLD, a mild loss of momentum conviction even as 1H trend stays down and the regime is now explicitly BEARISH. The setup stays INVALIDATED on the original entry trigger, with 4,141.44 the short level on any retest and 4,065.48 the downside target. Bias remains bearish; only a sustained close above 4,148.48 invalidates it.

Bias stays neutral-to-bullish but the momentum has cooled: price slipped from 1.34 back to 1.33 and the last 1H printed a flat-to-negative 1.33→1.33 (-0.19%), so the prior read's upside lean is intact but no longer advancing. The 4H direction holds Bullish, the combined 4H+1H signal remains HOLD with the SELL setup still invalidated, and the BULLISH regime label persists, so nothing has flipped. Key levels are unchanged: 1.33 is support with the bull FVG at 1.3304–1.3307 sitting just beneath it, a sustained push above opens the 1.43 upper pivot, and a drop back under 1.31 revives the 1.20 target. Invalidation: a sustained break back below 1.31.
